title: Uniform ergodicity and spectral gap of importance-tempered MCMC with heavy-tailed targets
abstract: arXiv:2506.19186v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the importance-tempered random-walk Metropolis (RWM) algorithm on $\mathbb{R}^d$, which targets the tempered density $\pi_\beta(x) \propto \pi(x)^\beta$ with $\beta \in (0,1)$ and corrects for the resulting bias by importance weighting. The dynamics of this sampler can be described by a continuous-time Markov chain whose embedded chain is the tempered RWM. We prove that when the tails of $\pi$ decay at rate $\|x\|^{-\gamma}$, this continuous-time chain is uniformly ergodic if and only if $d/\gamma < \beta < (\gamma - 2)/\gamma$. Further, the global spectral gap of this chain can be controlled via the spectral gap of the chain restricted to a ball with radius growing polynomially in $d$. Our theory and simulation studies show that, with a suitable choice of $\beta$, importance tempering can substantially reduce sensitivity to initialization and significantly improve efficiency over the standard RWM.

translated_title: 重尾目标分布下重要性加权退火MCMC的一致遍历性与谱隙
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上的重要性加权退火随机游走Metropolis（RWM）算法，该算法以退火密度 $\pi_\beta(x) \propto \pi(x)^\beta$（其中 $\beta \in (0,1)$）为目标分布，并通过重要性加权来校正由此产生的偏差。该采样器的动力学可以用一个连续时间马尔可夫链来描述，其嵌入链为退火RWM。我们证明，当 $\pi$ 的尾部以 $\|x\|^{-\gamma}$ 的速率衰减时，该连续时间链一致遍历当且仅当 $d/\gamma < \beta < (\gamma - 2)/\gamma$。此外，该链的全局谱隙可以通过限制在半径随 $d$ 多项式增长的球内的链的谱隙来控制。我们的理论和仿真研究表明，通过适当选择 $\beta$，重要性退火可以大幅降低对初始化的敏感性，并显著提高相对于标准RWM的采样效率。
tldr: 该论文针对重尾目标分布，给出了重要性加权退火RWM算法一致遍历性的充要条件（d/γ < β < (γ-2)/γ），并证明了适当选择退火参数β可显著降低对初始化的敏感性、大幅提升相对标准RWM的采样效率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the necessary and sufficient condition (d/γ < β < (γ-2)/γ) for uniform ergodicity of importance-tempered RWM with heavy-tailed targets, proving that appropriate tempering substantially reduces initialization sensitivity and significantly improves sampling efficiency over standard RWM.
